summary: StorageProfile(Profile) — base class for all provider settings classes. Inherits from mountainash_settings.profiles.Profile and adds to_handler_kwargs() which uses lookup_class_var for __adapter__ to dispatch to the per-provider adapter. Each provider settings class (S3Settings, etc.) is a subclass of StorageProfile.
extension_points: New providers subclass StorageProfile and set __adapter__ to their adapter module
lifecycle_notes: to_handler_kwargs() is the bridge from settings → SDK-ready kwargs dict
documentation_hooks: Document that to_handler_kwargs() is how settings are converted for SDK use — this is what users call if constructing backends manually
examples: CLAUDE.md: s3.to_handler_kwargs() → dict ready for boto3.client('s3', **kwargs)
